# TC-CLI-302 backup/restore 运行期错误码（契约 §4）：源不存在 E_NOT_FOUND(1)、源不是目录
# E_USAGE(2)、排除目录在源外 E_USAGE(2)、同名备份 E_EXISTS(1)、目标非空 E_TARGET_NOT_EMPTY(1)、
# 损坏备份 E_CORRUPT(1)。每次失败 stdout 最后一行都是 error 事件。

exec expect 1 --json backup --source $WORK/nope --repo $WORK/repo
stdout '"type":"error","code":"E_NOT_FOUND","message":"源目录不存在: '

exec expect 2 --json backup --source $WORK/file.txt --repo $WORK/repo
stdout '"type":"error","code":"E_USAGE"'

exec expect 2 --json backup --source $WORK/src --repo $WORK/repo --exclude-dir /etc
stdout '"type":"error","code":"E_USAGE","message":"排除目录 /etc 不在源目录内"'

exec databackup --json backup --source $WORK/src --repo $WORK/repo --name dup
exec expect 1 --json backup --source $WORK/src --repo $WORK/repo --name dup
stdout '"type":"error","code":"E_EXISTS"'

exec expect 1 --json restore --backup dup --repo $WORK/repo --target $WORK/full
stdout '"type":"error","code":"E_TARGET_NOT_EMPTY"'

exec expect 1 --json restore --backup dup --repo $WORK/repo --target $WORK/file.txt
stdout '"type":"error","code":"E_TARGET_NOT_EMPTY"'

cp $WORK/file.txt $WORK/repo/bad.dbk
exec expect 1 --json restore --backup bad --repo $WORK/repo --target $WORK/o
stdout '"type":"error","code":"E_CORRUPT"'
! exists $WORK/o

# 人类可读模式：错误写 stderr，stdout 为空
exec expect 1 backup --source $WORK/nope --repo $WORK/repo
stderr '^databackup: 源目录不存在: '
! stdout .

-- src/a --
a
-- file.txt --
not a backup
-- full/x --
x
